snippet.title: Imperial Command | Demo Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Imperial Command is a turn-based strategy board game inspired by Risk, Catan, and Civilization.

Conquer a hex-based map, gather resources, and build your economy as you battle for control in tactical, dice-driven combat. Play with friends in multiplayer.

Demo available now on PC and Steam Deck.
👉 Wishlist on Steam to follow development and get notified at launch.
bit.ly/ImperialCommand

Turn-based strategy • Digital board game • Multiplayer • Full controller support • Steam Deck compatible
